inventorytweaks.name: Inventory Tweaks
inventorytweaks.server.gesperrt: This server does not allow automatic inventory clicks – sorting is off.
inventorytweaks.cursor_voll: No free slot for the item on your cursor – not sorted.
inventorytweaks.seite.sortieren.info: Sort order, key and quick move
inventorytweaks.seite.warnung.info: Warning and sound when a tool is about to break

inventorytweaks.o.art.info: Order of the items; equal items are first combined into full stacks.
inventorytweaks.art.name: Name
inventorytweaks.o.ziehen.info: Hold Shift + left mouse button and drag over slots: every item moves instantly between inventory and container.

inventorytweaks.o.schwelle.info: Remaining durability at which the warning starts.
inventorytweaks.o.ton.info: Plays a sound once when a tool drops below the threshold.
